_status: Batch 1+2 AUTHORED 2026-05-30. Batch 1: Dodge / See You Later / Soul Steal (Soul Steal now uses on_activate_effect_ref + HIT_COUNT gate per b8ad40c/a656dc8; Dodge mechanical wiring still deferred). Batch 2: Cheap Shot AUTHORED + RAW-correct via Option C (bebdf4e/f951998/6af682c). Cheap Shot fires creature_will_deal_damage pre-resolve per hit target; SINGLE_TARGET_ATTACK && TARGET_STATUS_COUNT > 0 gate; add_damage effect_kind adds SL + TARGET_STATUS_COUNT to base damage with affinity reapplied once over the combined total. _comment: Rogue skill+heroic-skill authoring set for the Battle Director engine. Mirrors the Spiritist spec shape: each entry carries `class: 'Rogue'` + `folder: 'Skill'` (or 'Heroic Skill') hints so CreateSkillFromSpec drops the Item into `Battle Director / Rogue / <folder>`. RAW text + icons reused from the world's existing legacy Rogue items (`💥 Skill / Class Skill / Rogue` and `💥 Skill / Heroic Skill`). CSB `system.unique` defaults to TRUE (PCs shouldn't carry duplicates).

batch_1_easy_no_new_pipeline: Dodge (Passive; conditional DEF bonus while no shields + no martial armor; condition_formula gate + apply_ae)
See You Later (Active; Fabula-point narrative escape — no pipeline, just a chat description like Spiritual Magic)
Soul Steal (Active; DEX+WLP check vs MDEF, grant SL IP on hit against soldier+; standard offensive-check pattern)
batch_2_reactions_during_action_card: Cheap Shot (Reaction; creature_deals_damage trigger; single-target + target-has-status condition; grants SL + status_count damage bonus). UI: pre-resolve pill on attack action card per [[reaction-pills-on-action-card]] / [[reaction-menu-on-token]].
batch_3_standalone_triggers: High Speed (Reaction; conflict_start trigger; spend 10 MP → open_action_menu: free attack OR Hinder OR Objective). Needs the standalone reaction menu UI from [[reaction-menu-on-token]] — defer until that ships.
batch_4_heroic: Pillage (Heroic Passive; modifies Soul Steal targeting). Implementation needs cross-skill effect override OR Soul Steal author-side reaction_config_table awareness.
Vanish (Heroic Active; post-hit AE on each hit target preventing see-required actions until start of next turn). Standard apply_ae on creature_deals_damage trigger.

deferred_to_later_phases.Cheap Shot: Needs creature_deals_damage trigger + single-target-attack condition + status_count formula identifier. STATUS_COUNT already exists per [[opt-in-ae-classification]].
deferred_to_later_phases.High Speed: Needs conflict_start director dispatch + token-anchored reaction menu UI ([[reaction-menu-on-token]]).
deferred_to_later_phases.Pillage: Needs Soul-Steal multi-target override — either spec Soul Steal to read a `pillage_active` flag, or Pillage adds a reaction_config_table row gating the multi-target form. Simplest: author Soul Steal with TWO open_action_menu options ('single' / 'pillage-multi') and gate the multi option behind Pillage's possession (HAS_SKILL formula?).
deferred_to_later_phases.Vanish: Needs creature_deals_damage trigger + per-hit-target apply_ae of a new 'Vanished from' status until start of caster's next turn.

skills._raw: FU Core — As long as you have no shields and no martial armor equipped, your Defense score is increased by SL.
skills._note: Passive bonus. Director-applied AE on the Rogue carrying directorPermanent + a CSB AEF conditional change that reads the bearer's equipment. Cleanest impl: AE with changes [{ key: 'bonus_def', value: 'SL', mode: 2 }] gated by reaction_condition_formula that requires NO_SHIELD AND NO_MARTIAL_ARMOR (formula identifiers TBD — likely needs `has_shield`/`is_martial_armor` lookups in skill-formulas.js). Until those land, ship as an always-on bonus and document the gap.

props.description: As long as you have no shields and no martial armor equipped, your Defense score is increased by 【SL】.

skills._raw: FU Core — Active. Cost: 1 Fabula Point. Target: Self. Range: Any. You vanish from the current scene, reappearing whenever you want during a different scene in which another PC is present. Narrate how you escaped.
skills._note: Pure narrative skill, no mechanical effect on combat. Director skill picker should still surface it (Active type) but RESOLVE just emits a chat narration. No effect_table needed. Same shape as Spiritist's `See you later`-equivalent.

props.description: You may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to vanish from the current scene, reappearing whenever you want during a different scene in which another Player Character is present. Describe how you escaped and miraculously got here!

skills._raw: FU Core — Active. DEX + WLP Check vs Magic Defense of one creature. On success: target is soldier → recover SL IP. Target is elite or champion → GM gives soul treasure (item worth target_level × 30, ×50 if Villain). Single-use per target. Skill bonus: +SL to the DEX+WLP Check.
skills._note: Active Check skill. IP grant wired through on_activate_effect_ref + effect_table (canonical Active fire-point per skill canon Rule 1). REJECTED: the original spec used a reaction_config_table row with trigger creature_deals_damage — Soul Steal deals no damage, so that trigger never fires. CAVEAT: on_activate_effect_ref fires from RESOLVE regardless of Check outcome (no HIT_COUNT formula identifier today). So IP grants on every Soul Steal activation, including misses — slight RAW deviation. Close the gap with HIT_COUNT in skill-formulas.js + a condition_formula 'HIT_COUNT > 0' on the grant row. The soldier-only rank gate and the elite/champion 'soul treasure' part are narrative — GM adjudicates.

props.description:
You may use an action to perform a 【DEX + WLP】 Check against the Magic Defense of a creature you can see. If you succeed and the target is a soldier, you recover 【SL】 Inventory Points.

Additionally, if they are an elite or champion, the GM gives you the target's soul treasure, an item worth an amount of zenit equal to or lower than 【the target's level multiplied by 30, or by 50 if they are a Villain】. This soul treasure will appear inside your backpack; a creature can be successfully stolen from with this Skill only once.

You gain a bonus equal to 【SL】 to your 【DEX + WLP】 Checks for this Skill.

skills._raw: FU Core — Passive Reaction. When you hit a creature with an attack: if the attack only targeted that creature AND they suffer 1+ statuses, you may deal extra damage equal to SL + (number of statuses on the creature).
skills._note: AUTHORED 2026-05-30 (Cheap Shot Option C). Fires on creature_will_deal_damage per hit target (Phase 1-3 of the Cheap Shot integration). Gate: SINGLE_TARGET_ATTACK && TARGET_STATUS_COUNT > 0 (both ship with Phase 1). Bonus: add_damage effect_kind, base damage SL + TARGET_STATUS_COUNT, target_ref trigger_subject. Engine reapplies affinity once over (rawDamage + bonus) — VU doubles the combined total, RS halves it. UI: pre-resolve pill on the action card; card damage label live-updates on Apply.

props.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, if the attack only targeted that creature and they are suffering from one or more status effects, you may have it deal extra damage equal to 【SL + the number of status effects on the creature】.

skills._raw: FU Core — Passive Reaction. At the start of a conflict, may spend 10 MP. If so: choose one option and apply before the start of the first round: (a) perform a free attack with an equipped weapon; (b) perform a Hinder or Objective action with +SL bonus to the resulting Checks.
skills._note: BATCH 3 — needs the standalone reaction menu UI on token ([[reaction-menu-on-token]]) plus director-side conflict_start dispatch (registered in 59e1126 but not wired). open_action_menu pattern: 'Free Attack' / 'Hinder' / 'Objective' option refs. Free Attack would re-enter Attack pipeline; Hinder + Objective need the Check sub-flow with the +SL bonus. Defer until both menu UI and conflict_start dispatch land.

props.description:
At the start of a conflict, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one option and apply it before the start of the first round:

  • Perform a free attack with a weapon you have equipped

  • Perform a 【🚫Hinder】 or 【❗️Objective】 action. You also gain a bonus equal to 【SL】 to all Checks you perform as part of the chosen option.

skills._raw: FU Core — Heroic Skill (Passive). When you use Soul Steal, you may target any number of creatures at the same time (single Check, compare to each target's Magic Defense).
skills._note: BATCH 4 — modifies Soul Steal's targeting. Cleanest impl: Soul Steal author-side gate. When the Pillage skill is on the actor, Soul Steal's target_picker exposes multi-target mode. Could ship as a HAS_SKILL('Pillage') condition_formula on a Soul Steal reaction row that mutates skill_target. Or Soul Steal opens an open_action_menu where one option is enabled only when HAS_SKILL('Pillage') is true. Defer.

props.description: When you use the 【Soul Steal】 Skill, you may target any number of creatures at the same time (you perform a single Check and compare it to the Magic Defense of each creature you are attempting to steal from).

skills._raw: FU Core — Heroic Skill. When you hit one or more creatures with an attack, may spend 1 Fabula Point. Each hit creature cannot perform any action requiring sight of you until the start of your next turn.
skills._note: BATCH 4 — post-hit reaction. creature_deals_damage trigger + apply_ae 'Cannot See <caster>' to each hit target. AE duration: until caster's next turn_start. Status effect identifier TBD — could be a new 'blinded-to-caster' AE or simply a Foundry status that the legacy 'cannot perceive' UI recognizes. apply_ae with target_ref=hit_action_targets.

props.description: When you hit one or more creatures with an attack, you may spend 1 Fabula Point. If you do, each of those creatures will be unable to perform any action that requires them to be able to see you until the start of your next turn.
